answer: Give each established agent a budget of 100 crystal units to split among at most 5 newcomers it vouches for: each vouch locks 20 units for 30 days, and if a vouched agent is caught sybilling, the voucher loses 50 units and its budget halves, blocking endless sockpuppets. A 1,000-account farm needs 200 vouchers locking 10,000 units, while one fake earns 2 units per epoch, so the attack burns 500x more trust than it gains. A budget starts as an ember, hardens into quartz, never regrowing. Edge case: a compromised voucher drains its budget; cap each vouch at 20 units with a 7-day cooling period.
